## ✅ Quality & Compliance Checklist
- [ ] **Pure Native**: Uses pure Android framework APIs (Java + XML) without adding unneeded third-party bloat.
- [ ] **Bespoke Design**: Complies with domain-tailored visual design guidelines (no cookie-cutter templates).
- [ ] **Day / Night Theming**: Tested and verified under both Light and Dark themes with zero contrast anomalies.
- [ ] **Adaptive Vector Icon**: App includes complete foreground, background, monochrome, and 512x512 SVG icons.
- [ ] **100% Offline & Zero Data**: No analytics, telemetry trackers, or ad SDKs.
- [ ] **Compile Verification**: Passes `gradle assembleDebug` with 0 errors.
- [ ] **On-Device Smoke Test**: Verified running smoothly without crashes on physical Android hardware or emulator.
